Group 1 Mapping from http://whonet.org/CodeSystem/organism to SNOMED CT (all versions)

title.value: WHONET Organism Codes to SNOMED CT

description.value: Maps WHONET organism codes to SNOMED CT concepts. Derived from the AMR R package (https://github.com/msberends/AMR) which integrates WHONET organism codes with SNOMED CT mappings. Contains 4995 WHONET organism codes.
